digo_source: Mgombato ('mphunga rice (as crop)'; 'mtele'; 'wari'; 'bura paddy field'); Pakia ('Mphunga')

teaser.en: Coconut flowers are called *punga* because they look like the heads of the rice plant, *mphunga*.
teaser.sw: Maua ya mnazi huitwa *punga* kwa sababu yanafanana na mashuke ya mpunga, *mphunga*.
teaser.dg: Maruwa ga mnazi nkuihwa *punga* kpwa sababu ganaonekana dza masuche ga mphunga, *mphunga*.

summary.en: *Mphunga* is rice, the first staple of the Digo table. Cooked in coconut milk as *wali wa nazi*, it appears at nearly every meal.
summary.sw: *Mphunga* ni mpunga, chakula kikuu cha kwanza mezani kwa Wadigo. Ukipikwa kwa tui la nazi kama *wali wa nazi*, huonekana karibu katika kila mlo.
summary.dg: *Mphunga* ni mtele, chakurya cha kpwandza cha Adigo. Uchijitwa na huwi dza *wali wa nazi*, unaphahikana karibu chila wakati wa kurya.

about.en:
*Mphunga* is a cereal grass with narrow leaves and drooping heads of grain. It is grown in fields that flood seasonally, and the heads turn golden as the grain ripens.

Digo farmers grow several cultivars, including the aromatic *pishori*, *sindano* (also called *lokoli*), *mosi wa sigara*, *gushe* and *kanja*.
about.sw:
*Mphunga* ni nyasi ya nafaka yenye majani membamba na mashuke ya nafaka yanayoinama. Hulimwa katika mashamba yanayofurika maji kwa msimu, na mashuke hugeuka rangi ya dhahabu nafaka inapokomaa.

Wakulima Wadigo hupanda aina kadhaa, zikiwemo *pishori* yenye harufu nzuri, *sindano* (pia huitwa *lokoli*), *mosi wa sigara*, *gushe* na *kanja*.
about.dg:
*Mphunga* ni nafaka ya jamii ya nyasi, yenye makodza membamba na masuche ga tembe ganayoinama. Unaphandwa kpwenye minda inayoodzala madzi wakati wa mvula, na masuche ganakala ga rangi ya zahabu tembe zichiivwa.

Akurima a Adigo anaphanda aina nyinji, phamwenga na *pishori* yenye mzingo, *sindano* (inayoihwa piya *lokoli*), *mosi wa sigara*, *gushe* na *kanja*.

where.en: Rice is grown in low, seasonally flooded paddy fields called *bura*. Preparing a field for planting has its own verb, *siya*. Look for green paddies in low-lying ground during the rains.
where.sw: Mpunga hulimwa katika mashamba ya chini yanayofurika maji kwa msimu yanayoitwa *bura*. Kutayarisha shamba kwa ajili ya kupanda kuna kitenzi chake maalum, *siya*. Tafuta mashamba ya mpunga ya kijani katika ardhi ya chini wakati wa mvua.
where.dg: *Mphunga* unaphandwa kpwenye minda ya photsi inayoodzala madzi wakati wa mvula, inayoihwa *bura*. Kuandaa munda wa kuphanda mphunga kuna neno rakpwe, *siya*. Wakati wa mvula, lola minda ya mphunga ya chijani kpwenye tsi ya photsi.

uses.en:
Rice is the heart of coastal cooking. *Wali wa nazi*, rice cooked in coconut milk, is served at nearly every meal. *Mshombo* is rice cooked with green gram.

Rice is also ground into flour for *vitumbua*, small round rice cakes, and for *mkate wa kumimina*, a rice-flour bread baked with coconut milk.
uses.sw:
Wali ndio kiini cha mapishi ya pwani. *Wali wa nazi*, wali uliopikwa kwa tui la nazi, huandaliwa karibu katika kila mlo. *Mshombo* ni wali uliopikwa pamoja na pojo.

Mchele pia husagwa kuwa unga wa *vitumbua*, keki ndogo za mviringo za mchele, na wa *mkate wa kumimina*, mkate wa unga wa mchele unaookwa kwa tui la nazi.
uses.dg:
*Mphunga* ni moyo wa kujita kpwa pwani. *Wali wa nazi*, mtele uriojitwa na huwi, nkuandazwa karibu chila wakati wa kurya. *Mshombo* ni wari uriojitwa na podzo.

Mtele piya nkusagbwa unga wa kuhenda *vitumbua*, mikahe midide ya mtele, na *mkate wa kumimina*, mkahe wa unga wa mtele unaojitwa na huwi.

culture.en: The rice plant has given its name to other things. Coconut florets are called *punga* because they look like the heads of *mphunga*.
culture.sw: Mmea wa mpunga umetoa jina lake kwa vitu vingine. Vijua vya mnazi huitwa *punga* kwa sababu vinafanana na mashuke ya *mphunga*.
culture.dg: Dzina ra *mphunga* rikahumirwa kpwa vitu vyanjina. Maruwa ga mnazi nkuihwa *punga* kpwa sababu ganaonekana dza masuche ga *mphunga*.

names.en: Digo has separate words for the crop and the grain. *Mphunga* is rice growing in the field. Uncooked rice is *mtele* or *mtsele*; in older Digo *mtele* meant cooked rice, which is now *wari*. Swahili makes the same distinctions: *mpunga* (plant), *mchele* (grain) and *wali* (cooked). English: rice. Scientists call it *Oryza sativa*.
names.sw: Kidigo kina maneno tofauti kwa zao na kwa nafaka. *Mphunga* ni mpunga unaokua shambani. Mchele ambao haujapikwa ni *mtele* au *mtsele*; katika Kidigo cha zamani *mtele* ilimaanisha wali, ambao sasa ni *wari*. Kiswahili kina tofauti zilezile: *mpunga* (mmea), *mchele* (nafaka) na *wali* (uliopikwa). Kiingereza: *rice*. Wanasayansi huuita *Oryza sativa*.
names.dg: Chidigo china maneno ga tafwauti kpwa mmea na kpwa tembe. *Mphunga* ni mmea wa mtele unaomera mndani. Tembe zisizojitwa ni *mtele* au *mtsele*; kpwa Chidigo cha kare *mtele* kala ni mtele uriojitwa, ambao sambi ni *wari*. Chiswahili china tafwauti izo izo: *mpunga* (mmea), *mchele* (tembe) na *wali* (uriojitwa). Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *rice*. Kpwa chisayansi unaihwa *Oryza sativa*.

reason.en: Green gram, cooked with rice as mshombo
reason.sw: Pojo, zinazopikwa pamoja na wali kama mshombo

reason.en: Coconut, whose milk makes wali wa nazi
reason.sw: Mnazi, ambao tui lake hutengeneza wali wa nazi
reason.dg: Mnazi, ambao huwi ra nazize rinahenda *wali wa nazi*

reason.en: Cardamom flavours rice cakes and pilau
reason.dg: Iliki, inayoenjereza mzingo kpwenye mikahe ya mtele na pilau

definition.en: An ear of cereal such as rice or wheat. Pakia names the rice panicle suche ra mphunga.
definition.sw: Shuke la nafaka kama mpunga au ngano. Pakia analiita shuke la mpunga suche ra mphunga.
definition.dg: Seemu ya dzulu ya nafaka dza mphunga au ngano ambapho tembe zinamera. Pakia anaiha seemu iyo ya mphunga *suche ra mphunga*.

definition.en: Cleaned rice grain. Mgombato gives it as the rice plant or uncooked rice in modern use, and cooked rice in older use.
definition.sw: Mchele uliosafishwa. Mgombato analitoa kama mmea wa mpunga au mchele ambao haujapikwa katika matumizi ya kisasa, na wali katika matumizi ya zamani.
definition.dg: Tembe za mtele zirizoezwa. Mgombato unaandika kukala kpwa matumizi ga sambi ni muhi wa mphunga au mtele usiojitwa, na kpwa matumizi ga kare ni mtele uriojitwa.

meaning.en: From an old Bantu word for 'cleaned grain', which also gave tsere, maize.
meaning.sw: Kutoka neno la zamani la Kibantu lenye maana ya 'nafaka iliyosafishwa', ambalo pia lilizaa tsere, mahindi.
meaning.dg: Rinalavywa kula neno ra kare ra Chibantu ra 'tembe zirizoezwa', ambaro piya rikalavya *tsere*, matsere.

definition.en: Cooked rice. In older usage it meant cooked maize meal.
definition.sw: Wali. Katika matumizi ya zamani lilimaanisha ugali wa mahindi uliopikwa.
definition.dg: Mtele uriojitwa. Kare kala rinamaanisha unga wa matsere uriojitwa.

mgombato: mphunga (mi) rice (as crop); mpunga. (See: wari, mtele)
mtele (mi) 1) rice plant, uncooked rice (modern usage); mchele (luga ya kisasa). (See: mphunga) 2) cooked rice (old usage); wali (luga ya zamani). (See: wari)
